source: Not a book section. The plan, build and playtest shape follows CodeHS's project modules in Introduction to Game Design; the tile-map and grid-of-bricks ideas follow Video Game Design in JavaScript's tile and Breakout ladders. Structure only: no CodeHS text, problems or code is copied.

lessons.title: Plan, and a map is rows of text
lessons.objective: Students will be able to plan a game as parts and remembered values, and read a level written as rows of text.

lessons.title: Build the level
lessons.objective: Students will be able to set Group defaults and build a level from a map with Tiles and a legend.

lessons.title: The map as data
lessons.objective: Students will be able to scan a map for a letter, and convert between a row and column and pixels.

lessons.title: Coins, the goal and the levels
lessons.objective: Students will be able to pick up coins, open a goal only when none are left, and load the next level from a list of maps.

lessons.title: A grid is data
lessons.objective: Students will be able to build, draw, click and count an array of arrays, with the picture drawn from the data.

lessons.title: Playtest, check, and make it yours
lessons.objective: Students will be able to playtest their own work, link what they saw to their code, and extend it with a rule of their own.
